title: instrumentation-client.js
description: Learn how to add client-side instrumentation to track and monitor your Next.js application's frontend performance.

file allows you to add monitoring, analytics code, and other side-effects that run before your application becomes interactive. This is useful for setting up performance tracking, error monitoring, polyfills, or any other client-side observability tools.
